name: EPIC 220488681
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 10.8 solar radii and 1.15 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220488681 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.759017 (16th-84th percentiles 10.159867-11.457249), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220488681: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 5086.2383 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220488681 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 4589.84375 (16th-84th percentiles 4359.023438-4754.804688), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.17 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 4,590 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 1.15 solar masses and 10.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,086 K at its surface.
